# @leadconnector/vite-plugin-hmr-gate

Serve-only Vite plugin that holds HMR work until a control-plane request says a write batch is complete.

## Install

```bash
npm install --save-dev @leadconnector/vite-plugin-hmr-gate
```

## Usage

```ts
import { defineConfig } from "vite";
import { hmrGatePlugin } from "@leadconnector/vite-plugin-hmr-gate";

export default defineConfig({
  plugins: [hmrGatePlugin()],
});
```

- `GET /__hmr_gate` reports held work.
- `POST /__hmr_flush` releases held work.

## Modes

Classic Vite development queues `add`, `change`, and `unlink` watcher events. A flush invalidates affected modules, replays each unique event, and sends one full reload by default. Set `fullReload: false` for granular watcher replay.

Vite 8 `experimental.bundledDev` uses transport gating instead: broadcast `update` and per-client `bundled-dev-update` frames are queued and replayed to their original targets, non-startup reloads are held, and `<base>/hmr_patch_N.js` requests are parked until a flush opens the drain window. The initial resync reload always passes, even after a slow initial build. A held reload restarts the dev server after the drain; if no restart resync is observed, one raw full reload guarantees client freshness.

Both modes fail open automatically after `failOpenMs` (default: 240000) once work is held. Server shutdown restores wrapped transports and cancels parked requests with `503`.

Transport status and flush counts include queued frames, parked requests, and a held reload as one work item. Each Vite server generation owns its gate timers and held state, so a retiring server cannot release work queued after a restart. The plugin separately hands restart freshness expectations across generations: a successor resync clears the expectation, while a missed resync sends one raw reload through the current live generation.

## Options

```ts
interface HmrGateOptions {
  fullReload?: boolean; // default true
  failOpenMs?: number; // default 240000
  events?: Array<"change" | "add" | "unlink">;
  passthrough?: string[];
  drainMs?: number; // bundledDev default 1500
  maxHoldMs?: number; // bundledDev default 240000
  startupGraceMs?: number; // bundledDev default 5000
}
```

`node_modules/.vite` and `tailwind.config.vibe.json` always bypass classic gating.
Each `passthrough` value is matched as a file-path substring and is merged with
those defaults.
